news.summary: Slopsquatting is an emerging supply chain threat made possible by AI hallucinations in coding tools. This new type of supply chain attack injects malicious code into development workflows.

news.title: GenAI Success Metrics: Look Beyond Reduced Workload
news.summary_raw: Matt Harrison Clough / Ikon Images The Research The authors performed a four-year, fixed-window observational analysis of administrative work inside a large U.S. public higher-education institution. Generative AI tools were introduced to executive leaders, operational leaders, and student-facing professionals throughout the organization in 2026. Staffing levels and work hours remained stable across the period studied. […]
news.summary: A four-year study at a U.S. public higher-education institution found no reduction in workload despite the introduction of generative AI tools in 2026. The study calls for examining success metrics beyond just workload reduction.
news.enterprise_use: This study suggests that IT teams should not rely solely on workload reduction as a metric to measure the success of AI implementations. Consider evaluating other factors when assessing the impact of AI tools on your organization. Note this finding and revisit in 90 days to see how it aligns with your AI adoption strategy.
